mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_report_event (report_type, order_no, dedupe_key, exchange_order_id, exchange_seq, execution_id, exec_seq, source, applied, payload) VALUES (#{reportType}, #{orderNo}, #{dedupeKey}, #{exchangeOrderId}, #{exchangeSeq}, #{executionId}, #{execSeq}, #{source}, #{applied}, #{payload})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_report_event SET applied = 0 WHERE dedupe_key = #{dedupeKey}
mapper.select: SELECT exec_seq FROM t_execution WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} UNION SELECT exec_seq FROM t_report_event WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND report_type = 'EXECUTION' AND exec_seq IS NOT NULL
SELECT MAX(created_at) FROM t_report_event WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND report_type = 'EXECUTION'
